about: Landmark guardians (ART-L, WAR.md 'Living regions' > Landmarks). Each `sheet` is a soldier-format sheet in src/assets/sheets/<sheet>/ (SHEET_FORMAT v2; rows south-east, north-east, south-west, north-west; east rows are the west rows mirrored). `scale` is the manifest scale: 0.55 = the soldier's 33 px/m, 1 = 18 px/m (giants), 1.5 = 12 px/m (Drakon), so every guardian stands at true size beside the 1.76 m soldier. `clips` maps a guardian's moves to the sheet's clip names (the sheet player only knows SHEET_ANIMS). `fx` names strips in public/war/fx/objects.json; `fxScale` is the scale they play at (like a sheet scale: 1.5 = 2.7x the strip, a ~24 m breath cone). Prompts: docs/playbook/PROMPTS_ART.md > 40c.

drakon.note: P2 roof perch: play `brace` on the keep roof terrace (citadel-keep, heightM 16); `brace.hold` loops the wings-open crouch. P3 crash: `charge` (rears, slams down), then crash-dust at the anchor.

scylla_head.note: one head, drawn rising from the water; six instances along the cliff. Every row is the south-west view (the east rows mirrored): the heads face the shore. Its die sinks under the water.

fx.breath: breath strips at 0.4 scale from the goat head
